description: This Java source file defines the LoanRecoveryPaymentCommandHandler class, which handles loan recovery payment commands within the Fineract project. It implements a method to process repayment commands related to recoveries, utilizing the LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: LoanRecoveryPaymentCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing loan recovery payment commands, marked as a Spring service and associated with the RECOVERYPAYMENT action for loan entities.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to record a recovery payment on a loan by invoking the loan write platform service.
